name: @561-group/claude-code
description: Claude Code harness for SWARM: a thin carrier adapter that binds a running Claude Code session into the greenfield SWARM substrate. It decodes Claude IO into utterance-shaped capture rows, projects SWARM memory back into Claude context, and exposes an MCP tool surface. It owns no substrate math; every durable effect routes through SWARM's public ESM API. The harness depends on SWARM (development/lab/swarm) by relative path; SWARM never depends on the harness.
